_about: Bundle integrity manifest for canvas/index.html, verified by scripts/check-canvas-integrity.mjs (npm run check:canvas-integrity). canvas/index.html is AUTHORITATIVE for the single-file web surface: features land by inlining a js/ module into its one <script> block behind /* ---- from <path> ---- */ markers, not by rebuilding from src/. Each entry below pins BOTH the js/ source file's SHA-256 and the SHA-256 of its inlined canvas section, so editing one without re-injecting the other fails CI instead of silently diverging desktop (which loads js/ directly) from web (which runs the inlined copy). Add a path to "tracked" to opt that module into strict drift detection; after a deliberate re-injection run `npm run check:canvas-integrity -- --update` and review the hash diff like code.
